| Area | Lesson GruntWorx should inherit |
|---|---|
| **Rate limits** | Budget both **per connection/API group** and **across the whole app**. Check the group first so a rejected job does not consume the app budget; send unknown groups to a budgeted default. Instead defaults are 500 app requests/minute and 5 `docs` requests/minute per connection; production overrides these to **3,000 and 60**. These numbers are vendor-specific. Honor `Retry-After` as seconds or an HTTP date, and expose remaining/reset metrics. The normal retry budget is **10 retries**, roughly 4.5 hours on Sidekiq’s ladder, but throttling resets the attempt count—so it provides **no hard elapsed-time bound**. [Throttle](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/config/initializers/sidekiq.rb:100), [production limits](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/config/settings/production.yml:187), [retry policy](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/operation_worker.rb:10). |
| **Lost webhooks** | Treat webhooks as a fast path backed by bounded reconciliation. Instead sweeps every **30 minutes**, selecting uploaded documents still `sent` after **1 hour** or `processing` after **12 hours**, only within **2 days of upload**. Older records remain unchanged. It groups by entity/year, paginates folders, then fetches unseen documents individually to catch moves; an individual 404 becomes `archived`. Reconciliation shares the webhook status writer, making duplicate and backward reports harmless. Its workers make one attempt; a later sweep retries eligible records. Missing grants, owners, or provider availability defer recovery. [Schedule](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/clock.rb:194), [candidate bounds](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/queries/tax_preparation/tax_automations/documents/reconcile_candidates_query.rb:8), [pagination/fallback](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/reconcile_statuses_worker.rb:3), [individual lookup](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/reconcile_status.rb:38). |
| **Failure vocabulary** | Preserve the shared reasons: `unexpected`, `no_active_connection`, `network_error`, `unauthorized`, `api_error`, `exceeded`, `forbidden`, `encrypted`. Keep GruntWorx’s raw codes inside its adapter and map deliberately: Instead maps `password_required` to `encrypted`; unknown indexing failures become `error` without an invented reason. Separate terminal refusals from transient failures, and distinguish upload failure from processing failure. Clear obsolete reasons when recovery succeeds. [Shared model/state machines](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/document.rb:11), [refusal mapping](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/lib/tax_preparation/tax_automations/refusals_helper.rb:8), [status translation](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/apply_processing_status.rb:11). |
| **Signed-URL cassettes** | Scrub credentials **before recording**, across the cassette library. Existing hooks remove S3 policy/credential/signature fields and OAuth client secrets from request/response bodies; bearer and token scrubbing is currently Instead-host-specific, so GruntWorx needs equivalent coverage. Preserve payload shape for useful replay. Freeze replay time at the cassette’s first `recorded_at` so upload-target expiry behaves as recorded; new recordings use real time. The current body-field scrubber does **not establish coverage for secrets in signed URL query strings**—add that coverage if GruntWorx uses them. [Recording hook](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/spec/spec_helper.rb:164), [sanitization expectations](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/spec/unit/vcr/configuration_spec.rb:5), [replay clock](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/spec/support/vcr_fixed_time.rb:3). |
| **Entity matching** | Follow **stored link → unique normalized match → create**. Scope candidates to the firm, entity type, active status, and unlinked records. Normalize case, punctuation, and whitespace; business matching also normalizes legal-form spellings and `&`/`and`. Person matching tries swapped first/last names only after no direct match; account-name fallback requires a sole contact. **Never auto-link ambiguous namesakes**; emit match outcomes for visibility. Reuse entity identity across tax years. Instead’s create call is explicitly non-idempotent, so GruntWorx must establish its own duplicate-prevention strategy before retrying creation. [Workflow](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/export_async_workflow.rb:23), [matching rules](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/clients/link_entity_by_name.rb:14), [stored identity](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/clients/find_entity.rb:31), [creation semantics](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/clients/create_entity.rb:3). |
